constraints.critical_probability_when_positive: if Pcrit_raw > 0: sum_b u_b_raw z_b >= 0.99 * Pcrit_raw
constraints.nominal_exact_M4096: sum selected beam_sample_counts >= 3892; equivalently sum missed beam_sample_counts <= 204
constraints.zero_raw_criticality: if Pcrit_raw == 0 the critical constraint is vacuous; the nominal constraint remains active

historical_nonprimary_joint_absolute_bra.joint_form: P(Ccrit intersect Bmiss | Dt) <= 0.01; M=4096 integer cap <= 40
historical_nonprimary_joint_absolute_bra.paper_rule: Do not present the joint-absolute <=40 formulation as the C2 formulation executed in the current 9.13A -> R4 -> FORMAL chain.

notation.C: total raw critical Monte-Carlo sample count
notation.p_b: raw same-sample nominal beam probability mass
notation.u_b_raw: raw same-sample joint critical-beam probability mass
notation.z_b: binary beam-selection decision variable; z_b in {0,1}

novelty_boundary.safe_method_story: The contribution is the frozen shared future-state interface and safety-consequence-aware decision layer: criticality-constrained communication plus a secondary human-factors-informed recovery-aware ADB extension, not another predictor.

lexicographic_tiebreak: minimize raw critical missed sample count

solver_input_boundary.Pcrit_raw: solver input through same-sample raw critical-beam mass
